english:
Precision Kills grant a stack of 'Field Expertise' for 15 seconds. Maximum of 5 stacks.

Benefits at 1|2|3|4|5 stacks:
• 3.5%|7%|8%|9%|10% increased damage against non-Boss PVE Combatants
• 30 Reload Speed
• 5 Aim Assist

Non-Precision Weapon Kills immediately remove all stacks.

source.text:
4 Piece | Field Expertise

On Precision Kill:
Grants a stack of Field Expertise for 15 seconds, up to a maximum of 5 stacks.
Scoring a Non-Precision Weapon Kill immediately removes all stacks.

Field Expertise x1 | 3.5% Increased Non-Boss Combatant Damage, +30 Reload Speed, +5 Aim Assist.
Field Expertise x2 | 7% Increased Non-Boss Combatant Damage, +30 Reload Speed, +5 Aim Assist.
Field Expertise x3 | 8% Increased Non-Boss Combatant Damage, +30 Reload Speed, +5 Aim Assist.
Field Expertise x4 | 9% Increased Non-Boss Combatant Damage, +30 Reload Speed, +5 Aim Assist.
Field Expertise x5 | 10% Increased Non-Boss Combatant Damage, +30 Reload Speed, +5 Aim Assist.
